extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant of probate
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid Cheltenham estate valued at around £309,000 enquires about borrowing £33,500 to pay inheritance tax before the grant issues.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. We note you act for the executors of an estate of approximately £309,000 and are seeking £33,500 towards the inheritance tax liability. To take this further we would need the date of death and the IHT payment deadline, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, confirmation of which executors have been appointed and whether all will consent, and details of any other charges or borrowing against estate assets. Please also confirm your firm's contact details and whether you will be acting throughout the administration. A member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
